description: compilationHash does NOT exist in the current implementation. This file documents a PROPOSED formula (never implemented, never used to produce a real API response) and shows real, deterministically-computed example values for that formula, so a future implementation has a concrete, tested target rather than a vague description. See docs/bible/08-alchemist/175-definition-hash-vs-compilation-hash.md.
proposedFormula: sha256(f'{definitionHash}|{compilerVersion}|{geometryGeneratorVersion}|{forgeRuleSetVersion}').hexdigest()[:16] — deliberately modeled on the existing definition_hash() truncation scheme in backend/jewelmind/utils/hashing.py, not a new hashing convention.

vectors.note: Different definitionHash (four-prong-solitaire) yields a different compilationHash, as expected.

Same definitionHash, hypothetically-different compilerVersion, yields a different compilationHash — this is the entire point of a separate compilationHash: it changes when ANY output-affecting version changes, even if design intent (definitionHash) did not.

whyForgeRuleSetVersionIsPlaceholder: No aggregate Forge rule-set version currently exists (each of the 21 rules is independently versioned — see specs/forge/v1/current-rule-registry.json); 'none' is used as a placeholder string in these vectors, not a real value.
doNotSilentlyReplaceDefinitionHash: definitionHash (backend/jewelmind/utils/hashing.py::definition_hash()) is unchanged by this proposal and remains the current, real, tested model-cache key. compilationHash would be a NEW, additive identifier layered on top, never a replacement.
